title: Super Map!
hook: 天上掉下一件红斗篷，地图一下子变成了会飞的“超级地图”。

cells.en: Something red flies down from the sky. It is a red cape — for Map!
cells.cn: 天上飞下来一件红红的东西——是一件红斗篷，正好给地图用。

cells.en: Now Map is Super Map! He can fly and use his super breath.
cells.cn: 地图从此变成“超级地图”，会飞，还会吹出超级大风。

cells.en: Map says: “Jungle, river, Dora's House!” They must walk all the way home.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先过丛林，再下河，最后走回家。

cells.en: In the jungle they say hello to the baby birds. “Chipi, chipi!”
cells.cn: 丛林里有一群小鸟，他们挥手打招呼：“chipi，chipi！”

cells.en: Oh no! There are lots of snakes and spiders on this path.
cells.cn: 糟糕，这条路上到处都是蛇和蜘蛛，不能走。

cells.en: They have to super-jump across the logs. One, two, three — jump!
cells.cn: 他们只能“超级跳”，一根一根木头跳过去。

cells.en: They row a little red boat down the river. Super Map flies above them.
cells.cn: 他们坐上小红船顺流而下，超级地图在头顶飞着带路。

cells.en: At Dora's house there is a super duper slide. Down they go — whee!
cells.cn: 家门口有个超大的滑梯，他们一路滑下来，开心极了。

cells.en: Mami and Papi are waiting. “We did it!” everyone shouts.
cells.cn: 妈妈和爸爸在院子里等着，大家一起喊“我们做到了！”

opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Super Map!”.
ending: In the end, Super Map helps them get home. My favorite part is ______.
